id: title:Gilbert09:reject a secret key that can t be sent in a header

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a guard against non-ASCII characters in Clerk secret keys to prevent UnicodeEncodeError and an API request failure, with a corresponding regression test.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F3 and P1.F4 are absent, but P1.F1 and P1.F2 provide sufficient evidence for a Tier 1 score. P1.F1.H1 adds a non-ASCII check and an error message, preventing a potential runtime error and failed API request. P1.F2.H1 adds a test case to verify this guard. This is a localized, bounded maintenance and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The chunk is not complete; P1.F3 and P1.F4 are missing. This could potentially include broader changes or other relevant context, but the supplied hunks are sufficient for a Tier 1 assessment.

observations.limitations: This chunk is not a complete group. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 are supplied, but P1.F3 and P1.F4 are absent. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a non-ASCII check before the Clerk API request and a new error message for unsupported characters.
observations.posthog_connection: Prevents UnicodeEncodeError when the Clerk secret key contains non-ASCII characters, which would otherwise fail during the Authorization header encoding. This could help users avoid request failures and understand the root cause.

observations.behavior: Adds a test case with non-ASCII characters in the secret key to verify the guard rejects the key without making a request.
observations.code_quote: assert "Copy the key again" in (message or "")
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection for the credential guard, ensuring that non-ASCII keys are rejected before an API call is made.
